facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's health information system office (SIS), with an INE representative on the team, published the Anuário Estatístico da Saúde 2021 (second edition), compiled from health service data for 2016-2021, dated January 2022.

note: Birth and death counts in the yearbook are hospital (HAM) counts and INE projections, not civil-register vital statistics, so no vital fact.
